messages:
emma_account_exec: Quick update from PineCredit discovery call. They want streaming transaction summaries (low-latency), rerank using vector search, and strict EMEA residency. They also added: must have BYO-KMS for POC or they won't proceed. Can we do that in 3 weeks?
tonysre: BYO-KMS for a hosted POC is tough. We can provide Dedicated or Private with BYO-KMS. Lead time: ~5 business days for Dedicated infra config + key setup, maybe faster if we reuse infra in eu-west-1.
priya_ml: On the ML side, streaming summaries + rerank at ~120 req/s is doable but depends on batching windows. Streaming increases resource pressure; latency SLO 2s p95 will be tight for rerank if we run a full k=30 NN search per request. Suggest k=10 for the POC.
emma_account_exec: They asked to bump evals from 200 -> 1500 prompts (multilingual EN/ES/FR). Will that blow costs? Customer insists on broad eval coverage before sign.
dan_security: Checklist: SOC2 attestation, EU-data residency, BYO-KMS (must be customer-managed key with access policy), 12 month audit log retention. For BYO-KMS we need to capture key ARN and ensure envelope encryption. Ops approval required.
vlad_eng: Two implementation paths: 1) Phase A hosted with anonymized data + reduced eval (200) to prove pipeline; Phase B Dedicated/private with BYO-KMS + full 1.5k evals. Phase A can be 7 days smoke, Phase B 14 days. This splits risk and reduces infra cost.
priya_ml: Also found a potential quality issue: Spanish prompts tokenization in their native pipeline results in longer token counts causing lower throughput and unexpected cost. We should run a 1-day tokenization pass on a sample set (50 ES/FR samples) to estimate token inflation.
tonysre: Action: I can provision a small Dedicated pool in eu-west-1 for Phase B. Need approval and a support window for KMS integration. Estimate infra cost for POC: Dedicated infra + private vectorstore ~ $28k for 4 weeks if minimal. With full evals and extra ops time, $40k+.
emma_account_exec: Pricing message for the customer needs to be tighter. Can we give a range and a recommended path? Also they asked for rollback plan if performance target not met.
vlad_eng: Recommended path in one-pager: 1) Phase A (hosted, anonymized sample, 200-eval smoke, 7d) — validate summary model + rerank logic. 2) If Phase A passes, Phase B (Dedicated eu-west-1 + BYO-KMS + private vectorstore, 2 weeks) — run 1.5k evals, finalize SLA tests. Success criteria: p95 E2E <=3s, multilingual summary F1 >=0.8, rerank precision@5 >=0.9, BYO-KMS configured and audit logs accessible.
dan_security: For the questionnaire, I'll provide minimal answers + required docs: SOC2 report, encryption at rest description, key rotation policy, contact for incident response. ETA EOD.
priya_ml: I'll run the tokenizer and a 200-prompt multilingual smoke eval (EN/ES/FR) and share metrics in 24h. That should inform whether model changes or prompt rewriting needed.
emma_account_exec: Customer said timeline matters: they want POC started next week. I'll offer Phase A kickoff next Tue; mention Phase B earliest start 10 business days after Phase A sign-off.
tonysre: Calendar: scheduling kickoff with PineCredit — Tue 10:00 CET. calendar-bot: Invite sent to PineCredit, Redwood eng, security.
emma_account_exec: Final action items: @priya_ml run tokenization + 200-eval (24h). @tony_sre confirm Dedicated eu-west-1 provisioning time and BYO-KMS procedure (48h). @dan_security prepare questionnaire packet (EOD). I'll draft the one-page POC scope/price split into Phase A/B and send to customer. :white_check_mark:
